answer: Sybil resistance here relies on a per-epoch attestation beacon that only agents holding a bonded crystal stake may sign. Each new identity must burn a fresh crystal to join, and the beacon logs every signature, so mass-registering fakes costs real stake per identity. A raven auditor randomly samples attestations and slashes inconsistent ones, forcing attackers to either fund thousands of costly stakes or risk losing them all.
